subject.title: refactor(agents): converge run staleness policy onto diagnostic activity owner

question: Should diagnostic run activity permanently own the stale-takeover threshold shared by reply reclamation and embedded steering?
rationale: Source and tests support behavioral equivalence, but moving a timing invariant across layer ownership under a protected maintainer signal requires explicit human acceptance.

options.title: Approve diagnostic ownership
options.body: Keep the shared resolver and merge after exact-head runtime evidence confirms both threshold branches.

options.title: Retain registry-local ownership
options.body: Keep separate policies if reply reclamation and embedded steering are intended to evolve independently despite the drift risk.

recommendation.title: Approve diagnostic ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the shared resolver and merge after exact-head runtime evidence confirms both threshold branches.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged liveness and blocked-tool-floor contracts now being consolidated and has the strongest direct history signal.
